identity.description:
Remove the review-queue skill and the review-board mod

## Summary

This PR removes the review queue and the review board from crew. The principal now uses a team-built skill for this work, so the queue session, the board pane, the Slack watcher and the "child mode" of a single review are no longer necessary. The project lead, the single PR review and the delivered window stay as they are.

**Ticket:** N/A
**Type:** Refactor

---

## Agent context

### Authority

`docs/design.md` §15.138 records the removal. It marks §15.128, §15.129, §15.132, §15.135 and §15.136 as removed. For §15.130 and §15.133, it removes only the queue parts. `skills/project-lead/SKILL.md` "Standing instructions" owns the config sections. `record-format.md` owns the charter lines.

### What changed, by file

- `skills/review-queue/` (the skill, its four references and two scripts), `hooks/review-board.tsx`, `tests/review-board.test.tsx`, `types/index.d.ts`: deleted.
- `hooks/hooks.json`: no `modules` entry. `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`: no `types` entry. Both manifests are at 0.1.105.
- `skills/review/SKILL.md`: no child mode, no `Queue:` launch words, no `ready-file.md` row.
- `skills/review/references/github-review.md`, `skills/project-lead/references/review-runner.md`, `record-format.md`: the queue's inline read, the child-mode clean-up rule and the `Queue:` charter line are removed.
- `skills/project-lead/SKILL.md`: the `Pre-enqueue checks` and `Checkouts` config sections are removed (only the queue read them). The section count goes from thirteen to eleven.
- `README.md`, `CLAUDE.md`: the queue and the board are removed from the commands, requirements, config, glossary, layout, build state and authority lists.
- `docs/design.md`, `docs/tickets.md`: §15.138 is added, and the old sections and T84 to T87 have removal notes. The history is not changed.

### Constraints that applied

- A change to what the plugin loads bumps `version` in both manifests to the same value: 0.1.105.
- `docs/implementation-plan.md` and `docs/stage-2-run/` are not edited.
- The text about GitHub's merge queue (`queued`, `dequeued`, `dequeue-diagnosis.sh`) stays. It is not the review queue.

### How this was verified

A grep for `review-queue|review-board|queue session|asks\.json|queue-watch|board\.json|ready-file|child mode|/review-board` finds hits only in the design §15 history, in the T84 to T87 ticket bodies, and in the one CLAUDE.md sentence that records the removal. I read the diffs of the skill and reference files.

### Known gaps

`skills/project-lead/scripts/crew-stats.py` still skips a `<record-root>/queue/` directory when it walks the records. Old queue records can still be on disk, so the skip stays.
